sections.title: Booking a pottery class
sections.context: A phone call between a student and a community centre receptionist.

transcript.speaker: Receptionist
transcript.text: Good morning, Hillside Community Centre. How can I help you?

transcript.speaker: Laura
transcript.text: Hi, I'd like to sign up for the beginners' pottery course I saw advertised.

transcript.speaker: Receptionist
transcript.text: Of course. Can I take your surname, please?

transcript.speaker: Receptionist
transcript.text: Thanks, Laura. The course runs on Wednesdays, but we also have a Thursday evening group if that suits you better.

transcript.speaker: Laura
transcript.text: Thursday would be perfect, I work late on Wednesdays.

transcript.speaker: Receptionist
transcript.text: Lovely. That class starts at half past six, so six thirty. We only take eight people in each group, so the studio doesn't get crowded.

transcript.speaker: Laura
transcript.text: Is it in the main hall? I went there for a yoga class once.

transcript.speaker: Receptionist
transcript.text: No, the pottery classes are held in the art studio, behind the library. Just follow the signs from the car park.

transcript.speaker: Laura
transcript.text: Great. And how much is the fee? Does it include materials?

transcript.speaker: Receptionist
transcript.text: It's forty-five pounds for six weeks. That covers the clay and the firing of your finished pieces. Tools are free to borrow, but you have to pay for a certificate if you'd like one, and refreshments are not included.

transcript.speaker: Laura
transcript.text: That's fine. What will we be making?

transcript.speaker: Receptionist
transcript.text: In the first week everyone makes a simple mug. The second week is a bowl, and in the third week you'll try a vase, which is the hardest. After that you can choose your own projects.

transcript.speaker: Laura
transcript.text: Sounds good. Should I bring anything?

transcript.speaker: Receptionist
transcript.text: Just an apron, because the clay gets everywhere. We'll see you next Thursday, then.
